name: AWS Snowcone
overview: AWS Snowcone was a compact Snow Family edge/data-transfer device. AWS discontinued Snowcone effective November 12, 2024, and support for existing devices ended November 12, 2025.
examSignals: Do not select Snowcone for a current deployment; its support has ended
For online transfers evaluate DataSync; for physical transfer assess current AWS Data Transfer Terminal/partner options

compareWith.diff: Snowcone historically targeted smaller compact deployments; Snowball offered larger-capacity device options. Verify current product availability.
